title: Efficient Recycling Subspace Truncation Method for Periodic Small-Signal Analysis
problem: Krylov subspace recycling for periodic small-signal RF analysis accelerates simulation but increasing memory cost becomes a bottleneck in large-scale designs; restarting loses recycling benefits.
motivation: RF simulation at multiple frequency points is time-consuming; memory limitations force restart compromising efficiency gains from recycling.
method: Proposes recycling subspace truncation framework with efficient initial guess selection method and Floquet-based subspace truncation strategy to reduce memory while maintaining iteration benefits.
key_novelty: Floquet-based subspace truncation strategy balancing memory efficiency with recycling benefits in Krylov subspace methods.
contributions: Recycling subspace truncation framework for periodic small-signal analysis
Efficient initial guess method for truncated subspaces
Up to 2.5x speedup with reduced memory cost

metrics.speedup: up to 2.5x in same memory cost

primary_theme: Floquet-based subspace truncation for efficient RF simulation
